summary: Comprehensive architectural blueprint and execution plan for the Sara Al-Araby e-learning ecosystem (منصة سارة العربي للتعليم الإلكتروني), detailing Kotlin Multiplatform with Compose Multiplatform, Supabase real-time backend, age-adaptive student dashboards, collision-free scheduling, live virtual classroom with PDF sync & whiteboard, parent/instructor/admin portals, and localized multi-currency billing.
